name: @refarm.dev/lsp-code-ops
description: lsp-code-ops — the first non-agent effect-capable plugin: LSP rename/find-references surfaced to the agent via capability-tools

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/ci/cargo-run.mjs --copy wasm32-wasip1/release/lsp_code_ops.wasm dist/plugin.wasm component build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && node -e "const t=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('plugin.json','utf-8'));delete t._note;require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/plugin.json',JSON.stringify(t,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.build:wasm: node ../../scripts/ci/cargo-run.mjs --copy wasm32-wasip1/release/lsp_code_ops.wasm dist/plugin.wasm component build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && node -e "const t=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('plugin.json','utf-8'));delete t._note;require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/plugin.json',JSON.stringify(t,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.test:integration: echo 'No integration tests for this crate'
